Condition : 1 - Reason:
The application to vary Condition 52 (Privacy and blank wall issues) of approved planning permission reference 00505/P/P59 dated 8/12/06 by replacing "?no development above natural ground level (and for the avoidance of doubt natural ground level shall not include the podium deck and basement car park) shall take?" with "?no development above the podium deck shall take place?" would not affect the intention of the condition as imposed, subject to amendment including reference to drawings showing the extent of the podium deck in plan and section, in that floor plans for Wallis House and floor plans and elevation drawings for Buildings 3, 5, 6, 7, 9, 10, 12 and 16 would still need to be submitted before any development above the podium deck commences.

Replacement condition:
"Notwithstanding Condition 2 above, no development above natural ground level or podium deck, whichever as applicable as shown on drawing A1944 Z 1111 P1 (Extent of Podium Deck) and the drawing entitled 'North Brentford Quarter - Plan 6 - Podium Deck Section', shall take place (unless otherwise agreed, in advance and in writing, by the Local Planning Authority) until floor plans for the residential accommodation within Wallis House and floor plans and elevational drawings for Buildings 3, 5, 6, 7, 9, 10, 12 and 16 have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any such approval. 
Supporting note:

description:
Variation of Condition 52 of approved planning reference 00505/P/P59 dated 08/12/2006 to read as follows "Notwithstanding Condition 2 above, no development above the podium deck shall take place (unless otherwise agreed, in advance and in writing, by the Local Planning Authority) until floor plans for the residential accomodation within Wallis House and floor plans and elevational drawings for Buildings 3, 5, 6, 7, 9 10, 12 and 16 have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any such approval.  
Supporting note:
a) The detail submitted must include an assessment of whether living room and bedroom windows would meet the daylighting standard set by Building Research Establishment guidance and BS 8206:1992
b)  Any such approval would be subject to a condition requiring obscure glazing to not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
c)  Should the applicant seek and the Council, as Local Planning Authority, agree to discharge this condition on a phased basis, the Council will, in assessing any detail submitted, have regard to how the proposal would relate to buildings in other phases."
